test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 17 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Choose the correct passive voice transformation of the sentence:**

The dedicated researchers have already published the groundbreaking findings in a prestigious scientific journal.

options.text: The groundbreaking findings were already published in a prestigious scientific journal by the dedicated researchers.
The groundbreaking findings have already been published in a prestigious scientific journal by the dedicated researchers.
The groundbreaking findings have already published in a prestigious scientific journal by the dedicated researchers.
The groundbreaking findings are already published in a prestigious scientific journal by the dedicated researchers.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Identify the Tense:** The active sentence "have already published" is in the **Present Perfect Tense**.
 
• **Passive Structure for Present Perfect:** The formula is **Object + has/have + been + Past Participle (V3) + by + Subject**.
 
• **Step 1:** Identify the object "The groundbreaking findings" (plural) and make it the new subject.
 
• **Step 2:** Use the auxiliary verb **"have been"** to match the plural subject.
 
• **Step 3:** Maintain the adverb **"already"** between the auxiliary "have" and "been."
 
• **Step 4:** Include the agent "by the dedicated researchers" and the remaining prepositional phrase.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The groundbreaking findings have already been published in a prestigious scientific journal by the dedicated researchers."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "were already published" – This is the Simple Past Passive, which removes the "have" (Present Perfect) aspect of the original sentence.
 
• **Option 3:** "have already published" – This is still an active construction but used with the object as the subject, which is grammatically incorrect.
 
• **Option 4:** "are already published" – This is the Present Simple Passive, which changes the completion aspect of the tense.
